d:
Working on a quality English translation right now. Let me know if you want the official, less adequate translation to hold you over until them.

Lime's Notes:

This time, I drew Makima from Chainsaw Man.

The idea for this project started because I thought Makima looked cute with her hair down in the movie, and I wanted to draw her in a skirt.

The story is structured to suit Makima, with a female-dominant dynamic. To be honest, the introduction isn't great, but I managed to keep it concise and move quickly into the "gameplay."

I think I was able to include most of what I wanted to depict, so I'm satisfied with the work as a result.
